## What

A successful host build does not prove that its bundled testing core has a producing witness. WI-6554700010056966 found a fixed 30,000 ms `spawnSync` timeout around `ascii-escape-bundle.mjs <temporary worker> --check` in both the normal witness builder and the source-preview background compiler. A valid slow qualifier was killed; the host fallback then built an unwitnessed worker, which correctly refused testing calls.

## Why it matters

Preserve the real qualifier and producing custody checks. Raising a timeout or manufacturing a witness hides the failure class. The existing call-level detector requires refused testing calls before alerting; build-time evidence must already distinguish degraded testing from host availability.

## How to apply

Both paths now reuse `qualifyTestingCoreFinalBytes` in `scripts/lib/testing-core-witness.mjs`. It awaits the real child asynchronously, inherits complete diagnostics, and rejects nonzero or signalled exits. The enclosing build owns the process/deadline budget. The real ASCII helper `--check`, original input verification and final artifact digest remain mandatory before publication.

The CLI emits `TESTING_CORE_BUILD_PHASE` and records `testing-core-final-bytes` start/end in the existing `BUNDLE_HOST_STEP_LOG` journal. Background compilation retains `bg.compiler.core-final-bytes`. `bundle-host-common.sh` emits `TESTING_CORE_BUILD_STATE` and a structured `testing-core-witness` qualified/degraded event as soon as that state is chosen. Read these records and the qualifier diagnostics; a degraded worker still fails closed and does not imply the whole host failed to build.

## Verified recurrence guards

The native `testing-core-witness.test.ts` regression delays the real qualifier for 31 seconds. Old code failed with `status=null`, `signal=SIGTERM`, `error=ETIMEDOUT`; the repaired case passed in 32.690 seconds with its artifact digest verified. The killed-qualifier test still refuses publication. Local results: 36 witness tests passed; 9 shell tests passed; 7 focused `BG testing core` cases passed (707 unselected). Logs: `/tmp/ddcr-witness-slow-before.log`, `/tmp/ddcr-witness-all-after.log`, `/tmp/ddcr-witness-shell-final.log`, `/tmp/ddcr-witness-bg-after.log`. These are local working-tree results; commit/import provenance remains UNKNOWN, and they do not establish final shipment.
